<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>UCC Implementation:</strong> Home Minister Amit Shah announced that the Uniform Civil Code will be implemented across all 21 BJP-led NDA states before the 2029 Lok Sabha elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google._?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Nagaon Bypoll:</strong> The BJP has officially fielded Devasish Sharma for the Nagaon Lok Sabha by-election, a contest both the BJP and Congress view as a critical bellwether for national political trends.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxQc25nZ1ZsektscmdzRWg0dzMza2Y0SzNWa1Q3Nm1kOTlkMFJreklDaGhxTWI4OFgwdHRRcVBOVzR1N3RYNkFINThsTG00cEdtdjdCUVJTLXBxSEhDTGpPMHBGLVEtQ2E5dXJycmQ2WlNSbWNwTnVRV2FiZkFjY2J3b1hOZWdDb3FTRmJnZFRiY29fZmtmMkhFWlhGMUg2ajZxSEtUa3dQT2R1MWpiRWNVN0hwaXlNNUtvci1ORm11cXR5ZzdQTjBR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Opposition Criticism:</strong> The Congress party has targeted the Union government over its China policy following PM Modi’s meeting with President Xi Jinping, labeling the administration&#x27;s approach as &quot;calibrated capitulation.&quot;<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I7</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Goa Alliance:</strong> The Aam Aadmi Party and the Goa Forward Party have formed the &quot;Goa First&quot; alliance to contest the upcoming 2027 state assembly elections.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Rajya Sabha Results:</strong> BJP’s Sanjay Bhatia and Congress’ Karamvir Singh Boudh have secured victory in the recent Rajya Sabha elections held in Haryana.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W15</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNdEZhalJLdFY3Q1hERFFqTEMtZUk2ZkVEUGNFSGszYmhrY290XzcwaU5raWxPNzlYMml5anFXNWh0bWVIQzVhWUVZamFqY0xub1BDaDBCdDlMOW03OW9oUHJBalNNcWhha2Q4UkdGQVN2TkJ6Zmh5VFdwbEJmbUNNeUk3MnJFcy05cWxVbjg0WndUS2JJVl80MVFPSEFPVE1GTGxSdF9B?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W2</a></span></li>
